scenes.imageDescription: An illustration showing busy late 19th-century townsfolk—men and women in Victorian dress bustle through a lamp-lit street beneath a cloudy night sky. Above, faintly visible through the clouds, is the ominous shape of Mars shimmering red in the heavens, casting an eerie glow upon the crowded scene. The earth appears serene and unaware, contrasted with the looming threat afar, in a fine-art 19th-century style.
scenes.imageSubtitle: Humanity remains oblivious to the looming threat from Mars.

scenes.locationDescription: Imaginative view from Mars towards Earth
scenes.imageDescription: A dramatic scene from the imagined perspective of a Martian observatory, with shadowed figures of indistinct, otherworldly forms gazing through large, elaborate telescopic machines at a distant, glowing Earth. The reddish, desolate Martian landscape is partly visible outside polished glass windows, with cold, blue-tinted lighting illuminating the alien technology in a 19th-century illustration style.
scenes.imageSubtitle: Martian intelligences gaze at Earth from afar.

scenes.imageDescription: A historical montage: Victorian-era hunters stand over a fallen bison on a prairie, while explorers in 19th-century attire gaze sorrowfully at a museum exhibit of a dodo. In the background, a somber scene depicts European settlers clashing with an indigenous Tasmanian group amid subdued, sepia lighting—each group rendered in period-appropriate dress and appearance, evoking the moral weight of human conquests.
scenes.imageSubtitle: Contemplating human history of conquest and extinction.

scenes.imageDescription: A series of venerable astronomers—distinguished European men with beards, wearing late 19th-century suits—observe the red planet through large refractor telescopes housed inside domed observatories. Night sky and stars are visible through observation slits. The scene is thoughtful and diligent, with charts and celestial maps on desks, rendered in the style of a classic scientific illustration.
scenes.imageSubtitle: Astronomers track mysterious activity on Mars.

scenes.imageDescription: A dimly-lit Victorian observatory at night: a middle-aged man with sharp features and wire-rim spectacles (Ogilvy), in tweed, gestures excitedly beside a younger man in formal attire. A large telescope dominates the center, casting deep shadows; the lantern in the corner gives a small, golden pool of light. Through the opened roof, stars are visible in a moody, tense atmosphere.
scenes.imageSubtitle: Ogilvy invites the narrator to observe Mars.

scenes.locationDescription: At the telescope in nighttime observatory
scenes.imageDescription: Inside a shadowy observatory, a dark-haired Victorian man peers through a mounted telescope under the dim glow of a lantern. The room's floor is cluttered with scientific equipment and notes. The telescope is focused skyward through a slit in the domed roof, revealing a small, glimmering red dot of Mars in the deep indigo sky. The mood is one of awe and suspense.
scenes.imageSubtitle: The narrator and Ogilvy observe the planet Mars.

scenes.locationDescription: Night walk near Ottershaw, peaceful village setting
scenes.imageDescription: A tranquil, lamplit evening street in a village, featuring a young Victorian couple strolling under a star-strewn sky. The man gestures upwards toward Mars—a bright ruby among the stars. In the distance, a jovial group of excursionists in everyday late 1800s attire walks past with lanterns and instruments. Railway lights and nearby cottages glow warmly, conveying a sense of safety and simplicity.
scenes.imageSubtitle: The narrator and his wife walk under the starry sky.
